days.title: ビーチの街
days.morning: Po Nagar towers and Long Son Pagoda.
days.afternoon: Relax in a hot mineral mud bath.
days.evening: Stroll Tran Phu beach and eat seafood at Xom Moi market.

days.title: 4 島巡りツアー
days.morning: Snorkel the Hon Mun coral reef.
days.afternoon: Hon Tam, Bai Tranh and a floating party at sea.
days.evening: Fish cake noodle soup and Ninh Hoa grilled pork rolls.

days.title: ヴィンワンダーズ
days.morning: Take the sea-crossing cable car to Hon Tre.
days.afternoon: Water park and rides at VinWonders.
days.evening: Watch the Tata musical fountain show.

days.title: ビンバー – ビンフン島
days.morning: Visit Binh Ba, "lobster island", and swim at Nom beach.
days.afternoon: Snorkel and feast on lobster and sweet snails on a raft.
days.evening: Back in Nha Trang for the night market.

days.title: ゾックレット – ニンヴァン
days.morning: Swim at Doc Let's fine white-sand beach.
days.afternoon: Tram Trung hot springs and bird's nest shopping.
days.evening: Rooftop bar overlooking Nha Trang Bay.
